notes:
Original coefficients and J statistics are explicitly reproduced in Song's author-provided tables, but were not independently verified against the original paper; original value confidence is therefore false. Original n is null because Song explicitly inferred the printed 300 rather than observed the original analytic n. Coefficients are extracted as printed, without calculating t statistics or exact p values. Unstarred coefficient rows do not print p values; these are null. Original starred rows supply only significance bounds. Replication uses the 1970–1996 column selected by matching the original period. Author reports empirical confirmation while disputing the original interpretation of public goods as substitutes; successful records that empirical narrative, not an inference from p. No effect-specific separate verdict on lagged coefficients or J tests is stated; reported verdict is paper-level.
